summary: Implemented Profile page restructuring with new Match History component and added backend/query hooks to fetch caller-scoped availability days with per-day win/loss logs. However, the backend selection logic does not reliably return the most recent 5 availabilities, and the refactor of `useGetCallerAvailableDays` now appears to return only up to 5 days, which may break the Leaderboard date selector requirement to continue working with caller-scoped available days.

missing_requirements.requirement: Match History list must show the caller's last 5 availabilities played (most recent first).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend query `getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs` limits to 5 entries by taking the first 5 from `callerAvailabilities` before sorting; since `callerAvailabilities` is produced by `availabilities.filter(...).toArray()` with no demonstrated ordering, this does not guarantee the selected 5 are the most recent availabilities.

missing_requirements.requirement: Leaderboard page date selector continues to work for recording wins/losses using caller-scoped available days.
missing_requirements.reason: `useGetCallerAvailableDays` was changed to call `getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs()` and return `daysWithLogs.map(entry => entry.day)`. Since `getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs()` returns at most 5 days, the hook now likely provides only 5 dates, potentially breaking the Leaderboard date selector if it expects all of the caller’s available days.

hallucinated_features.description: Match History UI displays an extra per-entry label "No games recorded" when wins+losses equals 0.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 requires showing zero counts (or indicating zeros), but does not request an additional "No games recorded" badge per entry.
